'''Can-cells''' were large, winged insectoids of more than three [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length. On the ground, they walked on six spindly legs, but in the air, used four long wings to propel themselves, while their long, segmented tails provided stability. The can-cell was an insectivorous creature, but was also known to eat small rodents.

==History==
[[File:Aleenan_scout.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi]] riding a can-cell]]

The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] considered the appearance of a can-cell a good omen, and often kept them as pets. These animals were not dangerous to their masters, but were brave in battles. The Wookiees also realized that can-cells could be used as mounts, but they were too big to ride the insects themselves. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Tsui Choi/Legends|Tsui Choi]] performed reconnaissance missions during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] while riding a can-cell.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

They were ubiquitous, flying from the darkened forest floors to the highest treetops. This insect was not dangerous, however, and could be tamed by other species. Certain beings small enough were even able to ride them, such as [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] on Kashyyyk.

[[File:TethCan-cell-TCW.png|thumb|right|250px|A Tethan can-cell]]

Can-cells were also found on the planet [[Teth/Legends|Teth]], where they built their nests on the underside of rock ledges. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] rode a can-cell to [[Battle of Teth/Legends|escape]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] while rescuing [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Huttlet]].<ref name="TCW film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> A smaller breed of can-cell could also be seen flitting around the swamps of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].<ref name="BJ" /> They were also apparently found on [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]], where the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] under [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]] saw an [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] riding one as they descended with relief supplies.<ref name="Mercy Mission" />

==Behind the scenes==
The script to [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] described a scene of Yoda escaping the battlefields of Kashyyyk by riding atop a can-cell, "a large [[Alien/Legends|alien]] flying [[Insect/Legends|insect]]."

In a [[Content cut from Star Wars|deleted scene]] from the film, a smaller can-cell can be spotted as Yoda lands on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. In the first sweeping shots of [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], a similar animal can be seen.

The [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] describes the can-cells that appear in the film as "hunting flies" that are similar to can-cells but are unrelated,<ref name="novel">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref> but the [[Databank (original)|Databank]] explicitly identifies the creatures as can-cells.<ref name="DB" />
